title: Teeny Proms at Toynbee Hall – free music sessions for little people
intro: Free music sessions for children aged 3-5 on Wednesday 18th September with DaCapo Music and Proms at St Jude’s.

image.alt: small children playing with musical instruments

sections.text: Free music sessions for children aged 3-5 on Wednesday 18th September with DaCapo Music and Proms at St Jude’s.

We’re very excited to have our friends at DaCapo Music and Proms at St Jude’s join us on Wednesday 18th September for two music sessions for children aged 3-5 years old. If you know a little one who loves music, please do bring them along!
Sessions are free! Each session is 40 minutes – the first is at 10.30am, and the second at 11.30am. Places are limited so please book in advance on this page.
If you have any questions, please contact Lizzie! Maximum one adult accompanying one child.
